entries.title: Zechariah 9:1
segments: The burden of the word of Jehovah upon the land of Hadrach, and Damascus [shall be] its resting-place (for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Jehovah);

entries.title: Zechariah 9:2
segments: and Hamath, also, which bordereth thereon; Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:3
segments: And Tyre did build herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:4
segments: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:5
segments: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also, and shall be sore pained; and Ekron, for her expectation shall be put to shame; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:6
segments: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:7
segments: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also shall be a remnant for our God; and he shall be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:8
segments: And I will encamp about my house against the army, that none pass through or return; and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:9
segments: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy king cometh unto thee; he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, even upon a colt the foal of an ass.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:10
segments: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off; and he shall speak peace unto the nations: and his dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:11
segments: As for thee also, because of the blood of thy covenant I have set free thy prisoners from the pit wherein is no water.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:12
segments: Turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope: even to-day do I declare that I will render double unto thee.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:13
segments: For I have bent Judah for me, I have filled the bow with Ephraim; and I will stir up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and will make thee as the sword of a mighty man.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:14
segments: And Jehovah shall be seen over them; and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning; and the Lord Jehovah will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:15
segments: Jehovah of hosts will defend them; and they shall devour, and shall tread down the sling-stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:16
segments: And Jehovah their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for [they shall be as] the stones of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

entries.title: Zechariah 9:17
segments: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
